subject: Intro / Demo request — Redwood for GridOps (self-signup)

From: Sam Irvine <sam.irvine@gridops.io>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial signup + request for a quick demo

Hi Neha,

We just completed a self-serve signup for Redwood this morning (GridOps account). I'm the engineering lead here — thanks for making the product so easy to get started with. We'd like a 30–45 minute walkthrough to understand: streaming responses for low-latency retrieval, best practices for KV cache + prefix caching with our vector-store, and how private deployment (VPC) would work for our compliance needs.

Rough answers up front:
- Use case: real-time enrichment of operator consoles + incident post-mortems
- Volume: peak ~60–120 qps for short prompts, long-term 50M tokens/day
- Timeline: pilot in 6–8 weeks, production in ~4 months if rollout goes well

I attached a short architecture sketch and an SSO/SCIM checklist we have.

Availability this week: I’m Pacific time, mornings are better (8–11am PT) but can make afternoons as needed. Can you send a few time options?

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Irvine
Engineering Lead | GridOps
(415) 555-0162

Thanks for signing up, Sam — really appreciate the context and the attachments (they came through). I work on the SDR/solutions side and will run the walkthrough focused on the production constraints you mentioned. A few quick qualification items so we tailor the session: 

1) Are you already using a vector DB in prod? If so, which one and approximate index size?
2) For the 50M tokens/day target, is that mostly embeddings/lookup traffic or generation-heavy (long-form outputs)?
3) Which cloud provider would you prefer for a Private deployment (VPC)? Any regulatory constraints (e.g., SOC2, HIPAA) we should flag prior to the call?

Proposed 30-45m slots (all PT):
- Tue 05/19 9:30–10:15am PT
- Tue 05/19 2:00–2:45pm PT
- Wed 05/20 8:30–9:15am PT

If none of those work, tell me two times that do and I’ll get a calendar hold out. I’ll loop in one of our Solutions Engineers if you want deep-dive kernel/quantization discussion.

Quick notes on attachments: the architecture PDF is perfect for the demo — I’ll reference it.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Neha — thanks for the quick response. Answers inline below: 

1) Vector DB: We run Milvus in prod, current index ~120M vectors (80–90% static).
2) Traffic mix: ~70% retrieval/embeddings, ~30% short generation (single-shot <150 tokens) for enrichment. We have a smaller number of longer reports but those are batched.
3) Cloud: AWS (us-west-2) is preferred. We are SOC2-in-progress but will need logging/audit details for security review.

Of the slots you suggested, Tue 05/19 2:00–2:45pm PT looks best for the team — can we move it to 2:30pm PT instead? I have a standing 2:00 meeting that may run over. If that’s not possible, 9:30am PT works too.

—Sam
